question: How many distinct values can be obtained from <math><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></math> by inserting parentheses (no rearranging of factors)?
explanation: There are five full parenthesizations of the four operands 3, 4, 6, 2 (with operators ·, ·, +). Evaluate each grouping: <math><mo>(</mo><mo>(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>⋅</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>74</mn></math>, <math><mo>(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mo>(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>74</mn></math>, <math><mo>(</mo><mo>(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>⋅</mo><mo>(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>96</mn></math>, <math><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mo>(</mo><mo>(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>78</mn></math>, and <math><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mo>(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>96</mn></math>. The distinct values that appear are 74, 78, and 96, so there are 3 distinct results.

parameter_values.position_of_additive_term: attached to last operand (as '+k' after last factor)

derivation_summary: Enumerate the five full parenthesizations of 3 · 4 · 6 + 2, evaluate each grouping, and collect distinct numeric results: evaluations yield 74, 74, 96, 78, 96, giving three distinct values.
